**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | read new name, fall back to old |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | unset flag now `undefined`, threw | treat as `false` |

The 8 warnings are hardcoded strings in [build.js:18](build.js:18). They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here.

Next: nothing.
